title: Carter 1.0 Dataset Generation Result
description: Authoritative template contract for Carter 1.0 candidate dataset-generation responses. Dataset Forge compiles the application-approved DatasetSpec into the dynamic record portion before inference and validates Carter's response against that exact compiled schema after inference.

status.description: Whether Carter produced the complete candidate batch or determined that the exact requested batch cannot be generated without unsupported source content.

records.description: Candidate dataset records. Dataset Forge replaces the record-template contract with an exact schema compiled from the approved DatasetSpec before sending it to Carter.

dynamic_record_template.description: TEMPLATE ONLY. Dataset Forge must compile this definition into an exact record schema for the current approved DatasetSpec. The compiled schema contains the approved semantic fields plus the application-required evidence field.

x-dataset-forge-dynamic-record.description: Before model inference, Dataset Forge inserts one JSON Schema property for every approved semantic field and marks each DatasetSpec field with required=true as required. Carter never receives this uncompiled placeholder as the authoritative final output schema.

evidence_array.description: Exact source evidence supporting the semantic content of the generated record.

source_ref.description: An exact provider-visible source reference supplied by Dataset Forge for the current generation batch.

quote.description: A concise exact quotation from the quoteable source representation associated with source_ref.

message.description: A concise explanation of why Carter cannot safely produce the complete requested batch from the supplied source material.

rules: Never send the uncompiled dynamic_record_template to Carter as the final structured-output contract.
Compile one exact record schema from the application-approved DatasetSpec.
Insert exactly one semantic JSON property for each DatasetSpec field.
Do not add semantic fields that are absent from DatasetSpec.
Do not remove DatasetSpec fields.
Do not rename DatasetSpec fields.
Translate DatasetSpec field types into JSON Schema types using the field-type mapping in this contract.
Translate supported DatasetSpec field constraints into equivalent JSON Schema constraints.
Append the application-owned evidence property after semantic-field compilation.
Require evidence whenever DatasetSpec.evidence_required is true.
Use additionalProperties=false on every generated record.
Use the same compiled schema for RunPod and LM Studio.
Validate Carter output against exactly the schema that was supplied for that generation call.

json_schema.description: Dataset Forge sets enum to the exact DatasetSpec.enum_values collection.

rules: Apply only constraints defined and approved in DatasetSpec.
Do not invent constraints during compilation.
Reject internally inconsistent constraints such as min_length greater than max_length.
Reject minimum greater than maximum.
Reject min_items greater than max_items.
Every DatasetSpec field with required=true must appear in the compiled record required array.
Every DatasetSpec field with required=false remains optional.
evidence must appear in the compiled required array when evidence_required=true.
No application provenance field other than the explicitly defined temporary evidence field is model-authored.
For a DatasetSpec field whose type is enum, set the compiled property's enum array to exactly DatasetSpec.enum_values.
Preserve JSON primitive types of enum values.
Do not add aliases or synonyms.
Do not normalize capitalization after DatasetSpec approval.
Do not convert numeric or boolean enum values into strings.
An enum must contain at least two distinct values.
The static schema maximum of 100 is only the Carter 1.0 PoC global ceiling.
Before inference, Dataset Forge knows generation_batch.target_record_count.
When status is generated, Dataset Forge must additionally require records.length to equal generation_batch.target_record_count exactly.
Carter cannot authorize a smaller successful batch.
Carter cannot authorize a larger successful batch.
A response containing fewer records than the exact batch target must not be accepted as generated.
A response containing more records than the exact batch target must not be accepted.
When the exact target cannot be safely produced, Carter should use insufficient_source rather than duplicating or fabricating records.
JSON Schema validation confirms only the structure of source_ref and quote.
After structural validation, Dataset Forge must verify every source_ref against the current generation batch's allowed source-reference registry.
Dataset Forge must resolve provider-visible source aliases through origin-batch context before global assembly.
Dataset Forge must verify each quote against the quoteable source representation belonging to that exact source reference.
Evidence verification must not trust Carter's assertion that the quote is valid.
A structurally valid evidence object with an invented source_ref is invalid.
A structurally valid evidence object whose quote belongs to another source_ref is invalid.
No unresolved batch-local source alias may enter the canonical final dataset.
Passing this JSON Schema does not mean a record is grounded.
Dataset Forge performs deterministic grounding after source-reference resolution and evidence verification.
Carter must not emit grounding_status, grounding_score, schema_valid, validation_status, package_ready, or similar self-certification fields.
The final accepted dataset consists only of records that pass application-owned validation.
Carter should avoid duplicates during generation.
Dataset Forge performs authoritative exact-duplicate detection after generation.
Dataset Forge may perform deterministic near-duplicate analysis according to the existing quality pipeline.
Carter must not output duplicate_status or similarity_score fields.
Multi-batch duplicate analysis occurs after batch assembly.
The result contains only records for the current generation batch.
Do not include a model-authored batch_id.
Do not include a model-authored global record ID.
Do not include a model-authored canonical source ID.
Dataset Forge associates the provider response with the application-owned batch externally.
Dataset Forge performs origin-batch source-reference canonicalization before combining batches.
Source aliases valid in one batch are not implicitly valid in another.
Carter 1.0 PoC does not accept model-declared partial-success batches.
Either Carter generates the complete assigned batch or returns insufficient_source.
When status is insufficient_source, records must be empty.
Dataset Forge may retry according to its bounded provider policy, but Carter cannot initiate retries itself.
Insufficiency is not equivalent to provider failure.
Insufficiency means the model concluded the requested grounded records cannot safely be produced from the supplied source material under the active DatasetSpec.

x-dataset-forge-insufficiency-semantics.SOURCE_COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT: The supplied source material does not contain enough relevant information to produce the assigned batch safely.
x-dataset-forge-insufficiency-semantics.REQUIRED_FIELD_UNSUPPORTED: One or more required DatasetSpec fields cannot be populated without unsupported content.
x-dataset-forge-insufficiency-semantics.ENUM_VALUE_UNSUPPORTED: The requested source-grounded content cannot safely support the required enum semantics.
x-dataset-forge-insufficiency-semantics.DIVERSITY_UNACHIEVABLE_WITHOUT_DUPLICATI: Producing the complete target would require materially duplicating records.
x-dataset-forge-insufficiency-semantics.EXACT_TARGET_UNACHIEVABLE: The complete batch target cannot be produced while satisfying the approved DatasetSpec and grounding contract.

rules: Compile the runtime schema once from the approved DatasetSpec.
The logical compiled schema must be identical for RunPod and LM Studio.
If provider transports require different serialization wrappers, those wrappers must not change the schema semantics.
Do not maintain separate RunPod and LM Studio DatasetSpec compilers.
Do not relax schema requirements for Local mode.
Do not relax schema requirements for Cloud mode.

records.question: What is the purpose of regression testing?
records.answer: Regression testing verifies that existing behavior remains correct after a change.

evidence.quote: Regression testing verifies that existing behavior remains correct after a change.

records.question: What type of testing focuses on invalid inputs and expected failures?

evidence.quote: Negative testing checks invalid inputs and expected failure behavior.

insufficiency.message: The supplied source material does not contain enough distinct supported concepts to produce the complete assigned batch without inventing or materially duplicating records.
